saved mask comes from C6, which loads all region cells for 1991-12-27..2003-01-05 plus the 2010 summer (4120 days, matching a complete contiguous set). It builds per-doy hazen 90th-percentile pools with correct month/day doy mapping and smooths them circularly over 31 days. Only smoothed thresholds for doy 153-244 are indexed, which pulls in raw thresholds for doy 138-259 and thus baseline SST from May 12 to Sep 20 of each year 1992-2002; each target day of every sea cell is then compared and run-length processed into the mask."}
